playlist.description: The caption playlist at the stream root: the DVR one while live (captions_en_dvr.m3u8 for en), the ended one once sealed (captions_en.m3u8, rewritten in place since v0.8.0; it was captions_en_vod.m3u8).

vtt.description: The WebVTT transcript sidecar under the language's captions directory (captions/en/transcript.vtt for en); null while live

srt.description: The SRT transcript sidecar under the language's captions directory (captions/en/transcript.srt for en); null while live

json.description: The JSON transcript sidecar under the language's captions directory (captions/en/transcript.json for en): one row per final cue with word timings, the feed a control plane indexes; null while live

delivery.description: The delivery ULID. Matches X-Tmesis-Delivery. Duplicated in the body so a receiver that logs bodies has the dedupe key without the headers.

occurred_at.description: RFC3339 UTC, when the event happened on the node. ORDER BY THIS, never by arrival: delivery is unordered.

session.description: The publish session this caption session belonged to.

lang.description: The RFC 5646 tag this session captioned in.

provider.description: The STT provider: deepgram or self_hosted.

provider_request_id.description: The provider's id for the socket that closed; null when it never reported one.

reason.description: CLOSED set, additive inside v1: why the session closed. stream_ended, disabled and provider_switch are the node's own closes; auth_error and quota_exceeded are never retried and need an operator; rate_limited, provider_closed and unreachable are retried on a capped backoff, and gave_up is that cap reached. stalled (since v0.9.3) is the node ending a session whose provider was connected while audio was flowing and answered none of it for 60 s, answered it too late, or lost too much of it (detail says which); local silence and silence the provider answers empty are never a stall. Since v0.9.4 an outage (no live transport: the provider unreachable, refusing or dropping connections) is never a stall: a short one rides through on the same session with no end, and a long one ends gave_up about 60 s after the first failure. Since v0.9.1 gave_up, rate_limited, provider_closed and unreachable resume by themselves when the provider answers again, and since v0.9.3 so does stalled, no sooner than 15 s after the stall: a caption.session_started with resumed_after may follow in the same publish session. Since v0.9.2 a node with a transcription.fallback_provider may instead bring a degraded stream back on the other provider (auth_error and quota_exceeded included), and provider_switch is the node ending a working or retrying session to move the stream to its other provider, detail saying why: a caption.session_started with switched_from follows, on the other provider, in the same publish session.

detail.description: The provider's own message for the close, verbatim (a refused handshake's body, a close reason, an error string), never the key. null when the close had no message, which is every close the node made itself (stream_ended, disabled), except provider_switch, whose detail says why the node moved the stream, and stalled, whose detail says what the node measured.

finals.description: Final results journaled over the session.

dropped_pcm_ms.description: Audio dropped on the tap's ring or during a reconnect, in milliseconds: the same drop-and-count every media-path writer reports.

reconnects.description: Sockets re-opened after a failure, cumulative over the stream's captioner (a later caption.session_ended in the same publish session includes the earlier ones). None fires caption.session_started (since v0.9.3).

sockets.description: Provider sockets opened, cumulative over the stream's captioner like reconnects: every reconnect, rotation and re-anchor opens one, and none fires caption.session_started. A self_hosted socket counts once the sidecar has answered on it. Since v0.9.3.

rotations.description: Sockets replaced on purpose because the feed queue shed audio and the byte stream on a socket must stay contiguous, cumulative over the stream's captioner like reconnects; Deepgram only. Since v0.9.3.

artifacts.description: The seal's output for this language, the same object stream.sealed's vod.captions carries under this lang: present only on a stream_ended close after the seal wrote them, null on every other reason and on a live close.
